text:
ara: heads-up: i'm about to stage a 10% canary for orca-v1.3-int8. before i flip traffic, propose we add a provenance + tie-breaker rule to the rollout gate. details below.

ara: rationale: we've seen near-equal eval deltas between quantized variants before; we should prefer the artifact with stronger provenance (training seed stability, eval CI history, checksum + model.card). also want deterministic promote criteria so infra can auto-select fallback.

junaid: +1. how do you compute provenance score? is that a single scalar or multi-field?

kevin: proposal: provenance_score = weighted(artifact_age, stable-evals-count, seed-variance, checksum-match). normalize 0..1. require >= 0.7 to be eligible for auto-promote. otherwise model needs manual review.

claire: add one more: quant_profile tag (e.g., nf4-int8, int8-symmetric) must match tested profile in bench reports. and require model.card.url in release metadata.

ara: gating rules (draft):
- quality: composite_binary_pass = all critical_slices pass AND macro_delta_f1 <= 1.25%
- safety: toxicity & pii & hallucination_longdoc must be equals 1
- latency: weighted_p95 <= +10% and weighted_p99 <= +15%
- provenance: provenance_score >= 0.7 OR manual_override=true
- artifact-check: model.checksum_verified == true and model.card.url present
- fallback: transient window 180s -> pause ramp, sustained 300s -> auto-fallback, catastrophic safety -> immediate rollback

junaid: i like the provenance gate but suggest a tie-breaker: if two variants both qualify and one has higher token-efficiency (tokens/sec per GPU) prefer the more efficient one for promote. don't auto-promote if provenance close to threshold (0.68-0.7)

kevin: rollout-bot: can you confirm the canary will publish these telemetry keys and the provenance score metric?

rollout-bot: rollout-bot: scheduled canary start=1759001290 for model=orca-v1.3-int8 target=10%. metrics emitted: canary.slice.<name>.pass (0/1), canary.composite_pass (0/1), canary.weighted_p95_ms, canary.weighted_p99_ms, canary.provenance_score, canary.model.checksum_verified (0/1), canary.token_efficiency_tps, canary.overall_delta_pct

claire: adding quiet-shadow for 36h to collect rare-slice diffs. will attach bench links and model.card url to the rollout ticket.

ara: quick config snippet for the rollouter (yaml):
```yaml
rollout:
  target: 10%
  gates:
    - name: composite_pass
      type: binary
      required: 1
    - name: safety_pass
      type: binary
      required: 1
    - name: weighted_p99_pct
      threshold: 15
      comparator: less_or_equal
    - name: provenance_score
      threshold: 0.7
      comparator: greater_or_equal
    - name: model.checksum_verified
      required: true
  fallback:
    transient_seconds: 180
    sustained_seconds: 300
    catastrophic_immediate: true
  tie_breakers:
    prefer: [provenance_score, token_efficiency_tps]
  quiet_shadow_hours: 36
```

junaid: will watch the bench dashboard and post the 10m sample. if provenance_score hovers near cutoff i'll hold and escalate.

ara: thanks all. kicking off in 2m. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility :eyes:
